    MedEx.Capture (med_ex v0.2.0)

    Copy Markdown View Source

    GenServer that writes indexed mono 48 kHz PCM16LE audio to an immutable, content-addressed WAV file and fans full frames out to a bounded live Opus preview branch.

    Lifecycle & Ownership

    The host starts each capture under its own DynamicSupervisor (this module uses restart: :temporary and registers no global names). Capture monitors the :owner producer process and stops, removing its temporary .part file, if :owner exits before finish/1 succeeds. Only this PID may call push/3 and finish/1. Other callers receive {:error, :not_owner}.

    Preview Messages

    A preview peer owner calls subscribe/1 (single active subscriber; a newer subscriber replaces the previous one) and receives:

    • {:med_ex_preview, capture_pid, sample_index, opus_payload} — one encoded 20 ms Opus packet. After sending it with MedEx.Preview.send_opus/4, call demand/1 to request the next packet.
    • {:med_ex_preview_replaced, capture_pid} — sent to the displaced listener when a different process subscribes.
    • {:med_ex_preview_failed, capture_pid, reason} — sent if the internal Opus encoder exits. Capture itself continues uninterrupted and a new subscriber can re-subscribe.

    See Supervisor.

    demand(pid)

    @spec demand(GenServer.server()) :: :ok

    Signals readiness for the next {:med_ex_preview, ...} packet from the active preview subscriber.

    finish(pid)

    @spec finish(GenServer.server()) :: {:ok, MedEx.Evidence.t()} | {:error, term()}

    Flushes and fsyncs the WAV header, installs the content-addressed <file_sha256>.wav file, fsyncs :artifact_dir, and stops the capture.

    Returns {:ok, %MedEx.Evidence{}}, {:error, :empty_capture} if no samples were pushed, {:error, :artifact_conflict} if a conflicting file already exists at the target digest path, or {:error, reason} on filesystem failure.

    push(pid, first_sample, pcm)

    @spec push(GenServer.server(), non_neg_integer(), binary()) :: :ok | {:error, term()}

    Appends one contiguous mono 48 kHz PCM16LE chunk at first_sample.

    Chunks must start at sample 0, advance contiguously without gaps, contain an even number of bytes in 2..1920 (up to 960 samples / 20 ms), stay within the 30-minute maximum (86_400_000 samples), and send at most one short tail frame (< 1920 bytes) immediately before finish/1.

    A non-owner receives {:error, :not_owner} and recording continues. For the producer, returns :ok, or {:error, :invalid_frame | File.posix()} (stopping the capture process and discarding the temporary file).

    start_link(opts)

    @spec start_link(keyword()) :: GenServer.on_start()

    Starts a capture process linked to the caller (typically a host DynamicSupervisor).

    Required options

    • :owner — PID of the single PCM producer process. Capture monitors this PID and aborts if it exits before finish/1.
    • :acquisition_id — host-assigned string identifying this acquisition.
    • :artifact_dir — existing directory where the temporary .part file and final <file_sha256>.wav artifact are written.

    subscribe(pid)

    @spec subscribe(GenServer.server()) :: :ok | {:error, :preview_unavailable}

    Subscribes the calling process to bounded live Opus preview frames.

    Only one preview subscriber is active at a time; subscribing from a new process replaces the previous subscriber. Returns :ok or {:error, :preview_unavailable}.
